item.name: institute
item.description:
Institute setup under `/institute`.

**Auth:** Bearer `{{token}}` only — no `X-Institute-Id` required for create.

**POST /** creates institute + first active `academicYear` + optional `affiliatedUniversity[]` in one transaction.

`universityId` is injected from token; do not send `universityId` / `instituteId` in body.

request.description:
**POST /institute** — create institute, initial active academic year, and affiliated universities in one transaction.

### Required body
| Field | Notes |
|-------|--------|
| `campusId` | Must belong to authenticated university (`{{campus_id}}`) |
| `instituteName` | Display name |
| `instituteCode` | Unique code for institute |
| `academicYear.yearTitle` | e.g. `2025-2026` |
| `academicYear.startingDate` | Calendar start |
| `academicYear.endingDate` | Calendar end |

### Optional
| Field | Notes |
|-------|--------|
| `affiliatedUniversity[]` | Array of `{ affiliatedUniversityName, affiliatedUniversityCode }` |

### Auto-filled (not in body)
- `universityId` — from bearer token
- `createdBy` — logged-in user
- `academicYear.isActive` — always `true` for new institute

### 201 response
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "Institute created successfully",
  "data": {
    "instituteId": 12,
    "campusId": 11,
    "instituteName": "Engineering College",
    "instituteCode": "ENG-...",
    "affiliatedUniversity": [
      {
        "affiliatedUniversityId": 1,
        "affiliatedUniversityName": "State Technical University",
        "affiliatedUniversityCode": "STU-..."
      }
    ],
    "academicYear": {
      "acedmicYearId": 60,
      "universityId": 4,
      "instituteId": 12,
      "yearTitle": "2025-2026",
      "startingDate": "2025-07-01",
      "endingDate": "2026-06-30",
      "isActive": true
    }
  }
}
```

Test script sets `{{institute_id}}`, `{{acedmicYear_id}}`, `{{affiliated_university_id}}`.

item.name: academic year
item.description:
Academic year management under `/acedmicYear`.

**Auth:** Bearer `{{token}}`.

| Method | Path | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| POST | `/acedmicYear` | Upsert + activate for active institute (`X-Institute-Id` or default) |
| GET | `/acedmicYear` | All years (active + inactive) for active institute |
| PATCH | `/acedmicYear` | Update active year (or optional `acedmicYearId` in body) |
| DELETE | `/acedmicYear?acedmicYearId=` | Soft-delete one year |
| GET | `/acedmicYear/active` | Active years for **auth context** institute |
| GET | `/acedmicYear/active/:instituteId` | Active years for **login-selected** institute (no `X-Institute-Id`) |
| POST | `/acedmicYear/newActivateAndCopyData` | Activate + optional copy subjects/electives/sessions |

**Tenant scope:** Writes and list/update/delete use `scoped(acedmicYearModel)` — `universityId` from token, `instituteId` from `X-Institute-Id` / `defaultInstituteId`. Do **not** send `universityId` / `instituteId` in body.

**Login flow:** After user picks institute at login, call **GET /active/:instituteId** with bearer token only to populate academic year dropdown before `X-Institute-Id` is set.

**Validation:** Zod on POST, PATCH, DELETE, and `/active/:instituteId`. **400** → `{ status: "error", message, errors[] }`.

header.description: Active institute — required unless user has defaultInstituteId

request.description:
**POST /acedmicYear**

Upsert + **activate** academic year for the **active university + institute**.

### Required body
| Field | Notes |
|-------|--------|
| `yearTitle` | e.g. `2025-2026` |
| `startingDate` | Calendar start |
| `endingDate` | Calendar end |

### Auto-filled (not in body)
- `universityId`, `instituteId` — from auth context via `scoped().create()` / update
- `isActive` — always `true` after this call
- `updatedBy` — logged-in user

### Behavior
1. Deactivates other active years for this institute
2. If `yearTitle` exists for this institute → update dates and activate
3. Else if university-level orphan row (`instituteId` null) → claim for institute and activate
4. Else → create new row and activate

**201:** `{ message: "Academic year activated successfully", acedmicYear }`

Sets `{{acedmicYear_id}}` from response.

**GET /acedmicYear**

All academic years for the **active institute** (active + inactive), newest `createdAt` first.

Scoped via `universityId` + `instituteId` from auth — no query params.

**200:** array of academic year rows.

**GET /acedmicYear/active**

Only **activated** years (`isActive: true`) for the **active institute** from auth context (`X-Institute-Id` or `defaultInstituteId`).

**200:** array of active academic year rows (same shape as `/active/:instituteId`).

**GET /acedmicYear/active/:instituteId**

Active academic years (`isActive: true`) for the institute the user **selected at login**.

### When to use
- Login / institute-picker screen — user has token + chosen `instituteId` but may not have sent `X-Institute-Id` yet
- Same response array as **GET /active**, but institute comes from **URL param**, not auth header

### Params
| Param | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `instituteId` | yes | Path param — positive integer, e.g. `{{institute_id}}` |

### Auth
- Bearer `{{token}}` only (university from token)
- Institute must belong to user's university — **404** if not found
- **No** `X-Institute-Id` header required

### 200 response (array)
```json
[
  {
    "acedmicYearId": 60,
    "universityId": 4,
    "instituteId": 12,
    "yearTitle": "2025-2026",
    "startingDate": "2025-07-01",
    "endingDate": "2026-06-30",
    "isActive": true,
    "createdAt": "..."
  }
]
```

Test script sets `{{acedmicYear_id}}` from first row when present.

**PATCH /acedmicYear**

Update academic year for active institute (scoped).

**Default target:** active year from `X-Academic-Year-Id` (or token default). Omit `acedmicYearId` in body to update that year.

**Optional:** `acedmicYearId` — update a specific year instead.

**At least one of:** `yearTitle`, `startingDate`, `endingDate`

Tenant fields (`universityId`, `instituteId`, `isActive`) stripped from body.

**200** on success. **404** if not found in tenant scope. **400** if no active academic year in context.

**DELETE /acedmicYear?acedmicYearId=**

Soft-delete one academic year (scoped to active institute).

**200** on success. **404** if not found.

**POST /acedmicYear/newActivateAndCopyData**

Same upsert + activate as **POST /**, then optionally copy data from a previous year.

### Required body
`yearTitle`, `startingDate`, `endingDate`

### Optional
| Field | Notes |
|-------|--------|
| `copyAcedmicYearId` | Source year PK (from **GET /** history) |
| `copyData` | Array: `subject`, `electiveSubject`, `session` |

Omit `copyAcedmicYearId` / `copyData` to activate only (same as POST /).

**201:** `{ message: "Academic year activated and data copied successfully", acedmicYear }`

item.name: syllabus
item.description:
Syllabus CRUD, course/semester subject lookups, and **syllabus units** (topic slabs per subject).

**Base path:** `/syllabus`

**Auth:** Bearer `{{token}}`. Tenant scope from token/headers (`X-Academic-Year-Id` for year-scoped reads).

**Suggested flow:**
1. **GET courseSubject** — subjects for course + session
2. **POST /** — create syllabus with subject term marks
3. **POST addUnit** — add unit slabs for a subject
4. **GET getUnit?subjectId=** — list units for a subject
5. **PATCH unit** / **DELETE unit?syllabusUnitId=** — maintain units (DELETE uses scoped tenant only; no `acedmicYearId` in query)

request.description: **GET /syllabus?acedmicYearId=** — list syllabi for academic year.
**GET /syllabus/single?SyllabusId=** — single syllabus with details.

**Required:** `courseId`, `acedmicYearId`, `instituteId`, `sessionId`, `subjects[]` with `subjectId`, `subjectType`, `total`, `term[]` (`examSetupTypeId`, `type`, `marks`).
**PATCH /syllabus** — `SyllabusId` required in body.
**DELETE /syllabus?SyllabusId=**
**GET /syllabus/courseSubject** — subjects for course + session (syllabus setup helper).
**GET /syllabus/semesterSubject?semesterId=** — subjects linked to syllabus for a semester.

**POST /syllabus/addUnit**

**Required:** `subjectId`, `acedmicYearId`, `sessionId`, `slab[]` (`unitNumber`, `name`).

**Optional:** `semesterId` (nullable for session-level units).

**Optional slab fields:** `description`, `contactHours`.

item.name: time table
item.description:
Timetable APIs under `/timeTable` (structure/periods) and `/timeTableCreate` (routine + grid cells).

| Phase | Base | Purpose |
|-------|------|--------|
| Structure | `/timeTable` | Reusable bell schedule template + period rows |
| Routine | `/timeTableCreate` | Link one structure to a **classSectionTermId** + date range |
| Mapping | `/timeTableCreate/mapping` | Fill day/period cells (`class_schedule_item`) |
| Publish | `/timeTableCreate/publish` | Lock routine for students/teachers |

**Structure reuse:** one `timeTableNameId` can be used by multiple courses and multiple routines. Do **not** send multiple `courseId` values in `POST /timeTable`; create the structure once (usually with `sessionId` and no `courseId`), then create one routine per class/course term using the same `timeTableNameId` and that term's `classSectionTermId`.

**Placement key:** `classSectionTermId` (from `class_section_term`). `classSectionsId` + `term` are not sent on routine create — backend resolves `classSectionsId` and routine `courseId` from the term row.

**Tenant scope:** `scoped()` injects institute + academic year from auth context. Do not send `acedmicYearId` on create.

**Validation:** Zod on `/timeTableCreate` routes. Invalid input → **400**.

**Suggested flow:** `POST /timeTable` (structure) → `POST /timeTableCreate/` with same `timeTableNameId` + one `classSectionTermId` per routine → mapping → publish → getRoutine.

Folder vars `timetable_*` + collection `classSectionTermId`. Auth: Bearer `{{token}}`.

variable.description: Session PK — required for reusable structure POST
Campus PK — required on routine create

request.description:
**POST /timeTable**

Creates a timetable **structure** (period slots). A structure is a reusable bell schedule template; it is not the class routine itself.

### Body

| Field | Type | Required | Nullable | Description |
|-------|------|----------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | String | No | No | Structure name shown to users. |
| `sessionId` | Integer | Yes* | No | Session PK. Required when `courseId` is omitted; recommended for reusable structures. |
| `courseId` | Integer | No | Yes | Optional legacy/default course link. Do not send an array. Omit this field when the same structure should be reused by multiple courses. |
| `maximumPeriod` | Integer | No | No | Number of period rows to create. |
| `periodLength` | Integer | No | No | Period length in minutes. |
| `periodGap` | Integer | No | No | Gap between periods in minutes. |
| `startingTime` | String | No | No | Example: `09:00 AM`. |
| `type` | Enum | No | No | `Automatic` or `Manual`. |
| `weekOff` | String[] | No | Yes | Week-off day names, example `["Sunday"]`. |
| `isCourse` | Boolean | No | Yes | Stored on generated period rows. |

### How to use one structure for multiple courses

Create the structure once with `sessionId` and without `courseId`. Save the returned `timeTableNameId`. Then call `POST /timeTableCreate/` multiple times with the same `timeTableNameId` and different `classSectionTermId` values. The routine `courseId` is resolved from each selected class section term.

### Enum: `type`

```
Automatic
Manual
```

**200** — array of created period rows. **400** — Zod or business validation JSON/text.

### Changelog

**v2 (2026-07)**

- Documented reusable structure flow.
- `courseId` is optional and should be omitted when one structure is shared by multiple courses.

query.description: Optional — ignored; tenant scope from auth context

request.description:
**GET /timeTable**

Lists timetable structures with periods, optional course, session (`timeTableSession`), and `weekOff`.

**Query:** optional `courseId`. For reusable structures created without `courseId`, omit this filter; otherwise course-less reusable structures will not appear in a course-filtered response. Scoped via `scoped(timeTableStructureModel)` (institute + academic year from token).

**Optional ignored:** `acedmicYearId` (frontend compat).

query.description: Optional — ignored; tenant scope from auth context

request.description:
**GET /timeTable/all_name**

Same shape as **GET /timeTable**. Optional `courseId`, `sessionId`. For reusable structures shared across courses, prefer filtering by `sessionId` only and omit `courseId`. Tenant scope from `scoped(timeTableStructureModel)`.

query.description: Optional — ignored; tenant scope from auth context

request.description:
**GET /timeTable/single**

Optional `courseId`, `sessionId`. Scoped via `scoped(timeTableStructureModel)`. Includes session info and `weekOff`.

**PATCH /timeTable**

Non-empty array of period updates. Each item **requires** `timeTableCreationId`. Optional: `startTime`, `endTime`, `periodName`, `isCourse`, `isBreak`, `type`.

**400** — Zod validation JSON on invalid body.

**DELETE /timeTable?timeTableCreationId=**

Soft-deletes one period row. **Required query:** `timeTableCreationId`.

**POST /timeTableCreate/**

Creates a **routine** after a structure exists. This links one reusable `timeTableNameId` to one `classSectionTermId` for a date range.

### Request body

| Field | Type | Required | Nullable | Description |
|-------|------|----------|----------|-------------|
| `timeTableNameId` | Integer | Yes | No | Structure PK from **POST /timeTable**. The same value can be reused for many routines. |
| `classSectionTermId` | Integer | Yes for `normal` | No | Program/class term placement. Backend resolves routine `courseId` from this term. |
| `campusId` | Integer | No | Yes | Campus PK. |
| `timeTableType` | Enum | No | No | `normal` or `elective`. Default: `normal`. |
| `startingDate` | String | No | Yes | Routine active start date, `YYYY-MM-DD`. |
| `endingDate` | String | No | Yes | Routine active end date, `YYYY-MM-DD`. |
| `courseId` | Integer | No | Yes | Optional override/legacy field. For normal routines, backend uses the selected `classSectionTermId` course. |
| `timeTableRoutineId` | Integer | No | Yes | Used only in split/replace flow. |
| `previousDate` | String | No | Yes | Used only with `timeTableRoutineId` in split/replace flow. |

### Enum: `timeTableType`

```
normal
elective
```

### Multiple courses with one structure

Do not send multiple course IDs in this request. Call this API once per class/course term, using the same `timeTableNameId` and a different `classSectionTermId`.

Example flow:

```json
{
  "timeTableNameId": 10,
  "classSectionTermId": 101,
  "campusId": 1,
  "timeTableType": "normal",
  "startingDate": "2026-01-01",
  "endingDate": "2026-06-30"
}
```

Then create another routine with the same structure:

```json
{
  "timeTableNameId": 10,
  "classSectionTermId": 205,
  "campusId": 1,
  "timeTableType": "normal",
  "startingDate": "2026-01-01",
  "endingDate": "2026-06-30"
}
```

**Not accepted:** `classSectionsId`, `term`, `acedmicYearId` — `classSectionsId` and routine `courseId` are resolved from `class_section_term`; academic year from `scoped()`.

**400** if structure missing, term not found, session mismatch, or overlapping dates for the same term.

Saves `timeTableRoutineId` → `timetable_routineId`.

### Changelog

**v2 (2026-07)**

- Documented that one `timeTableNameId` can be reused for multiple routines/courses.
- Routine `courseId` is resolved from `classSectionTermId`; structure `courseId` is not used as a course lock.

**POST /timeTableCreate/clone**

Copies a routine and all its mapping cells to a new date range.

### Body (Zod)
| Field | Required | Type | Notes |
|-------|----------|------|-------|
| `previousRoutineId` | yes | int | Source routine PK (`timeTableRoutineId`) |
| `startingDate` | yes | string | `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| `endingDate` | yes | string | `YYYY-MM-DD`; must be >= `startingDate` |

No optional fields on this route.

Preserves `classSectionTermId`, course, campus, and all period mappings from the source routine. New routine is created unpublished (`isPublish: false`). Overlap is checked for the same `classSectionTermId`.

**400** if source routine not found or dates overlap an existing routine for that term.

**GET /timeTableCreate/single?courseId=**

Routines filtered by course.

item.name: get routine by course and section

request.description:
**GET /timeTableCreate/create**

Routines for a course/term with flattened `periods` array for the UI builder.

**Required query:** `courseId`, `classSectionTermId`.

**Optional:** `timeTableType` (`normal` | `elective`).

**PATCH /timeTableCreate/create**

Updates routine metadata. **Required:** `timeTableRoutineId`. Prefer `classSectionTermId` for placement changes. Re-validates date overlap for the term.

## Create Timetable Mapping Cell

**HTTP method:** `POST` · **Endpoint:** `POST /timeTableCreate/mapping` · **Auth:** Bearer `{{token}}`

Creates a **new** timetable cell. For **copying** an existing cell, use the sibling request **"add mapping (copy cell)"** in this folder (minimum payload: `sourceTimeTableMappingId` + `copyTarget`).

### Request body (create single cell)

See raw body on this request. **Required:** `timeTableRoutineId`, `timeTableCreationId`, `period` (and typically `day`).

### Field documentation (create mode)

| Field | Type | Required | Nullable | Description |
|-------|------|----------|----------|-------------|
| `timeTableRoutineId` | Integer | Yes | No | Routine PK |
| `timeTableCreationId` | Integer | Yes | No | Period row PK from structure |
| `day` | String | Yes* | No | e.g. `Monday` (*required in practice) |
| `period` | Integer | Yes | No | Period number |
| `timeTableNameId` | Integer | No | Yes | Structure PK |
| `employeeId` | Integer | No | Yes | Teacher PK |
| `subjectId` | Integer | No | Yes | Subject PK |
| `electiveSubjectId` | Integer | No | Yes | Elective subject PK |
| `teacherSubjectMappingId` | Integer | No | Yes | Teacher–subject mapping PK |
| `classRoomSectionId` | Integer | No | Yes | Classroom PK |
| `timeTableType` | Enum | No | Yes | `normal` \| `elective` |
| `isSameTeacher` | Boolean | No | Yes | |
| `teacherType` | String | No | Yes | |
| `isAttendence` | Boolean | No | Yes | |
| `isOverridingSyblingElectives` | Boolean | No | Yes | |
| `classSectionTermId` | Integer | No | Yes | Defaults from routine |

### Copy mode (separate request)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `sourceTimeTableMappingId` | Integer | Yes | Source cell PK |
| `copyTarget` | Enum | Yes | See below |

### Enum: `copyTarget` (copy mode only)

```
nextPeriod   → same day, next teachable period
nextDay      → same period, next working day (skips weekOff)
```

Full copy-mode docs, override fields, responses, and errors are on **add mapping (copy cell)**.

### Other modes

- **Multi-slot:** `timeTableRoutineId` + `day` + `slots[]` — see **add mapping (multi-slot / combined)**.

### Success response (200) — single cell

```json
{
  "timeTableMappingId": 64,
  "timeTableRoutineId": 12,
  "classSectionTermId": 197,
  "timeTableCreationId": 1,
  "period": 1,
  "combinedGroupId": null,
  "copiedFromTimeTableMappingId": null
}
```

### Errors (400)

Validation, teacher/room conflict, duplicate cell, or routine already started. Copy-specific errors documented on **add mapping (copy cell)**.

## Copy Timetable Mapping Cell

**HTTP method:** `POST`

**Endpoint:** `POST /timeTableCreate/mapping`

**Authentication:** Bearer token required (`Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`). Tenant scope (`universityId`, `instituteId`, academic year) is applied from auth context.

### Description

Copies the full source timetable cell into the **next period** or **next working day**. If the selected source cell has multiple `class_schedule_item` rows in the same routine/day/period/timeTableCreationId (for example, two teachers in one period), the backend copies all of those rows in one request.

Source siblings are scoped by `timeTableRoutineId`, `day`, `period`, and `timeTableCreationId`. They are **not** fetched across other routines that share the same structure (`timeTableNameId`), because one structure can be reused by multiple courses/routines.

### Request body — minimum

```json
{
  "sourceTimeTableMappingId": 64,
  "copyTarget": "nextPeriod"
}
```

Alternate valid value:

```json
{
  "sourceTimeTableMappingId": 64,
  "copyTarget": "nextDay"
}
```

### Field documentation

| Field | Type | Required | Nullable | Description |
|-------|------|----------|----------|-------------|
| `sourceTimeTableMappingId` | Integer | Yes | No | PK of any row in the source cell to copy. |
| `copyTarget` | Enum | Yes | No | `nextPeriod` or `nextDay`. |
| `employeeId`, `subjectId`, `electiveSubjectId`, `teacherSubjectMappingId`, `classRoomSectionId`, `timeTableType`, `isSameTeacher`, `teacherType`, `isAttendence`, `isOverridingSyblingElectives` | Mixed | No | Yes | Optional overrides. Omit for a straight copy. |
| `timeTableCreationId`, `timeTableNameId`, `day`, `period` | Mixed | No | Yes | Do not send. Computed by backend from source + `copyTarget`. |

### Enum: `copyTarget`

```
nextPeriod
nextDay
```

### Success response (200)

```json
{
  "isCopy": true,
  "copiedFromTimeTableMappingId": 64,
  "mappings": [
    {
      "timeTableMappingId": 85,
      "timeTableRoutineId": 12,
      "classSectionTermId": 197,
      "timeTableCreationId": 3,
      "period": 2,
      "day": "Monday",
      "copiedFromTimeTableMappingId": 64
    },
    {
      "timeTableMappingId": 86,
      "timeTableRoutineId": 12,
      "classSectionTermId": 197,
      "timeTableCreationId": 3,
      "period": 2,
      "day": "Monday",
      "copiedFromTimeTableMappingId": 65
    }
  ]
}
```

### Error responses

| Status | Message (examples) | Reason |
|--------|----------------------|--------|
| 400 | `copyTarget is required when sourceTimeTableMappingId is sent (nextPeriod \| nextDay)` | `sourceTimeTableMappingId` sent without `copyTarget`. |
| 400 | `Source mapping {id} not found` | Invalid source mapping. |
| 400 | `No next period available for this timetable structure` | `nextPeriod` but no further teachable period exists. |
| 400 | `No next working day available in this timetable structure` | `nextDay` but all following days are week-off. |
| 400 | `Target cell already has a mapping on {day} period {period}` | Destination slot is occupied. |
| 400 | `Teacher Conflict: ...` / `Room Conflict: ...` | Copied teacher or room clashes. |
| 401 | Unauthorized | Missing or invalid token. |

### Business rules

1. Copy mode starts when `sourceTimeTableMappingId` is present.
2. `copyTarget` is mandatory and must be `nextPeriod` or `nextDay`.
3. Target cell must be empty before any copied row is created.
4. Teacher and room conflicts are checked for every copied row.
5. Routine must not have already started.
6. Response is always grouped for copy mode, even when only one row is copied.

- Copy mode now copies every row in the selected source cell.
- Source siblings are scoped to the same routine, not just the same structure.

## Delete Class Section Terms

**HTTP method:** DELETE

**Endpoint:** DELETE /classSections/term?classSectionId=

**Authentication:** Bearer Token Required (Authorization: Bearer {{token}})

**Tenant scope:** Institute and academic year come from login defaults (`PUT /user/saveUserDefaults`). Optional `X-Institute-Id` header.

### Description

Deletes one class section completely:

1. All `class_section_term` rows for the section
2. The parent `class_sections` row (soft delete)

Send `classSectionId` (`class_sections.class_sections_id`). Save this from **POST /main/classSections** (`{{classSectionsId}}`) or **GET /classSections** — not `classSectionTermId`.

### Query Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| classSectionId | Integer | Yes | Positive integer. `class_sections.class_sections_id`. |

### Business Rules

* Deletes all term rows, then soft-deletes the class section so it disappears from section lists.
* Section must exist in the current institute + academic year scope.
* Blocks deletion when **teacher section mapping** exists (`teacher_section_mapping`).
* Blocks deletion when **timetable teacher cells** exist (`class_schedule_item.employeeId` on routines for those terms).
* Blocks deletion when **timetable routines** still reference any of the section's terms.
* Blocks deletion when **students** are assigned via `students.class_section_term_id` or `class_student_mapper.class_section_term_id`.

### Removed Fields

| Field | Status | Replacement |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| classSectionTermId | Removed | classSectionId |

### Success Response (200)

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Class section deleted successfully",
  "data": {
    "success": true,
    "message": "Class section deleted successfully.",
    "classSectionId": 101,
    "deletedCount": 6,
    "classSectionDeleted": true
  }
}
```

### Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| data.classSectionId | Number | Deleted class section ID. |
| data.deletedCount | Number | Number of `class_section_term` rows removed. |
| data.classSectionDeleted | Boolean | `true` when the `class_sections` row was soft-deleted. |

### Error Responses

**Teacher mapping still present (400):**

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Remove teacher mapping before deleting this section.",
  "errors": null
}
```

**Timetable routines still present (400):**

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Remove timetable routines before deleting this section.",
  "errors": null
}
```

**Students still assigned (400):**

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Remove or reassign students before deleting this section.",
  "errors": null
}
```

**Not found (404):**

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Class section not found.",
  "errors": null
}
```

### Error Codes

| Status | Reason |
|--------|--------|
| 400 | Zod validation, teacher mapping, timetable routines, timetable teacher cells, or students still linked |
| 401 | Unauthorized |
| 404 | `classSectionId` not found in current institute/academic year scope |
| 500 | Internal Server Error |

### Prerequisite Cleanup

```
Remove teacher section mapping → DELETE/PATCH /teacher/teacherSection
Remove timetable routines / teacher cells → DELETE /timeTableCreate/mapping
Reassign/remove students from all terms for the section
↓
DELETE /classSections/term?classSectionId={{classSectionsId}}
```

### Changelog

v2

- Query changed from `classSectionTermId` to `classSectionId`.
- Deletes all `class_section_term` rows and soft-deletes the parent `class_sections` row.
- Success response includes `deletedCount` and `classSectionDeleted`.

item.description:
Library issue/return flow under `/libraryIssueBook`.

**Test order:** create ΓåÆ get all/get single ΓåÆ **get inventory issue history** (by `inventoryId`) ΓåÆ update with `returnItems` (partial/full return) ΓåÆ update due date/inventory if needed.

**Rules**
- `memberType`: `STUDENT` | `TEACHER`; `memberId` maps to student/employee PK
- Transaction: `issueDate`, `dueDate` (`dueDate` >= `issueDate`)
- Return is stored in `library_return_book_transaction`; inventory item links via `libraryReturnBookTransactionId`
- Active issue = item row with `libraryReturnBookTransactionId` NULL; same `inventoryId` can be re-issued after return
- For same `returnDate`, one return transaction can be reused for multiple returned items
- `library_book_inventory.status`: `available` ΓåÆ `issued` on issue, back to `available` on return
- `inventoryItems[]` on update replaces outstanding copies (auto-returns old active items)
- `returnItems[]` on update returns selected books by item id or inventory id
- **GET /inventoryIssueHistory?inventoryId=** ΓÇö accession copy + all issue rows for that inventory (nested `bookDetails`, `issueBookTransaction` with `studentMember` / `teacherMember`)

Auth: Bearer {{token}}

request.description:
**POST /libraryIssueBook**

Creates transaction + items (initially `libraryReturnBookTransactionId` is `null`). Sets each `library_book_inventory.status` to `issued`.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `memberId`, `memberType` | Yes | STUDENT ΓåÆ student_id, TEACHER ΓåÆ employee_id |
| `issueDate`, `dueDate` | Yes | `dueDate` >= `issueDate` |
| `inventoryItems[]` | No | Copy must be `available`; unique per request |

**GET /libraryIssueBook**

List issue transactions with pagination and common search.

### Params type (frontend)

```ts
type GetAllIssueTransactionsQuery = {
  page?: number; // default 1
  limit?: number; // default 20
  search?: string; // optional common search
};
```

### Notes
- Send params in query string (no request body)
- `search` works across member/date/book related fields

**GET /libraryIssueBook/inventoryIssueHistory**

Query: `inventoryId` (required) ΓÇö `library_book_inventory.inventory_id` (accession copy).

Returns:
- `book` ΓÇö inventory row with nested `bookDetails` (`title`, `authors`, `isbn`, `accessionNumber`, `status`, ΓÇª)
- `issueCount` ΓÇö total issue entries for this copy
- `issueHistory[]` ΓÇö each `library_book_issue_inventory_item` with nested `issueBookTransaction` (`issueDate`, `dueDate`, `memberType`, `studentMember` or `teacherMember`) and optional `returnBookTransaction` (`libraryReturnBookTransactionId`, `returnDate`)

404 when `inventoryId` not found.

**GET /libraryIssueBook/returnTransactions**

Lists return batches grouped by `library_return_book_transaction` (one row per **returnDate**). Multiple books returned on the same date appear under the same record.

### Query params

```ts
type GetReturnTransactionsQuery = {
  page?: number; // default 1
  limit?: number; // default 20
  search?: string; // returnDate, member, accession, title, isbn, ΓÇª
};
```

`{{baseurl}}/libraryIssueBook/returnTransactions?page={{page}}&limit={{limit}}&search={{search}}`

### Response shape (per row)

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `libraryReturnBookTransactionId` | PK of return batch |
| `returnDate` | Shared date for all books in this batch |
| `totalReturnedBooks` | Count of copies in this batch |
| `totalIssueTransactions` | Distinct issue transactions involved |
| `issueTransactions[]` | Grouped by original issue |

Each `issueTransactions[]` entry:
- `libraryIssueBookTransactionId`, `memberId`, `memberType`, `issueDate`, `dueDate`, `member`
- `returnedBooks[]` ΓÇö `{ libraryBookIssueInventoryItemId, inventoryId, book }` (`book` includes `bookDetails`)

### Example (two books, same returnDate)

item.name: assetCategory
item.description:
## assetCategory

**POST body:** `{ "name": "..." }` only ΓÇö do **not** send `codePrefix` (server sets it from name).

| Name (seeded / example) | `codePrefix` |
|-------------------------|-------------|
| IT Assets | IT |
| Furniture & Fixtures | FURN |
| Software & Licenses | SWL |
| Custom e.g. Electronics | ELEC (derived) |

**PATCH:** `assetCategoryId` + optional `name`. Prefix is not changed on update.

Run **get all** after migration to pick an existing seeded category instead of **create**.

request.description:
**POST /assetCategory** ΓÇö create category.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `name` | yes | Do **not** send `codePrefix` |

Response: `assetCategoryId`, `name`, `codePrefix` (e.g. IT Assets ΓåÆ `IT`). Sets `{{assetCategory_id}}`.

Prefer **get all** and use an existing seeded **IT Assets** row when migration has already run.

**Other examples (valid JSON only in Body):** `{ "name": "Electronics" }` ΓåÆ prefix `ELEC`. Seeded: Land & Buildings (`LDB`), Furniture & Fixtures (`FURN`).
**GET /assetCategory** ΓÇö list categories for institute. Each row includes `codePrefix` (used for auto asset codes).
**GET /assetCategory/single?assetCategoryId=** ΓÇö `assetCategoryId`, `name`, `codePrefix`.

**PATCH /assetCategory** ΓÇö `assetCategoryId` required; at least `name`.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `assetCategoryId` | yes | |
| `name` | yes (on PATCH) | `codePrefix` is read-only ΓÇö not accepted in body |
Fails if any **asset** rows still reference this category.

**POST /asset** ΓÇö Create asset + inventory. **Do not send `code`** ΓÇö response includes auto `code` (e.g. name **Table** in **Furniture & Fixtures** ΓåÆ `FURN-TBL001`) and `inventoryItems[].code` (e.g. `FURN-TBL001-0001`).

**`inventoryBulk[]`** (optional on create; omit key for master-only):

| Row field | Required | Notes |
|-----------|----------|--------|
| `count` | yes | Min 1 per row |
| `classRoomSectionId` | no | Omit or `null` ΓåÆ `NOT_ASSIGNED`; set ΓåÆ `ASSIGNED` |

Example: 2 in room + 2 unassigned = 4 copies. Unassigned-only: `"inventoryBulk": [{ "count": 4 }]`.

Required master: `name`, `condition`, `assetCategoryId`. Body must be strict JSON (no `//` comments).

**GET /asset/codepreview** ΓÇö read-only preview of the next auto-generated asset `code` for `name` + `assetCategoryId`.

Does **not** save or reserve the code. **POST /asset** with the same `name` and `assetCategoryId` assigns the next available code at save time (usually matches preview unless another asset was created in between).

**Response:** `name`, `assetCategoryId`, `assetCategoryName`, `code` (e.g. `IT-DLL001`).

query.description: Optional. Partial match on asset name, code, or category name

request.description:
**GET /asset** ΓÇö paginated list.

| Query | Default |
|-------|--------|
| `page` | 1 |
| `limit` | 20 (max 100) |
| `status` | `all` ΓÇö filters nested `inventoryItems` only (`assigned` \| `unassigned`) |
| `search` | optional ΓÇö partial match on asset `name`, `code`, or category `name` only |

**Response:** `data.assets[]` each with `totalInventory`, `issuedCount`, `nonIssuedCount`, `inventoryItems[]` (`issueStatus`: `issued` \| `available`), `pagination` (`page`, `limit`, `total`).
**GET /asset/single?assetId=** ΓÇö asset master + `totalInventory`, `issuedCount`, `nonIssuedCount`, `inventoryItems[]` (code, barcode, status, `classRoomSectionId`, `classRoom`).

**PATCH /asset** ΓÇö Same **`inventoryBulk[]`** as POST create. `assetId` required; at least one other field. Body must be strict JSON (no `//` comments).

| Optional | Purpose |
|----------|--------|
| `name`, `condition`, `description`, `assetCategoryId` | Master (`code` read-only) |
| `inventoryBulk[]` | Append copies: each row **`count`** required, **`classRoomSectionId`** optional |

Append-only example: `{ "assetId": 1, "inventoryBulk": [{ "count": 3 }] }`. Does not update existing inventory lines.
**DELETE /asset/inventory?assetInventoryItemId=** ΓÇö 409 if issued and not returned.
**DELETE /asset?assetId=** ΓÇö blocked if inventory exists or items still issued.

item.name: assetIssue
item.description:
## Asset issue / return (all APIs)

**Prerequisite:** **asset ΓåÆ create** first. Use `{{assetInventoryItem_id}}` on issue (must be `NOT_ASSIGNED` or returned).

| # | Method | Path | Notes |
|---|--------|------|--------|
| 1 | POST | `/assetIssue` | Issue; optional `securityAmount` |
| 2 | GET | `/assetIssue` | List ΓÇö no payments |
| 3 | GET | `/assetIssue/single` | One issue ΓÇö includes `securityPayment` if any |
| 4 | GET | `/assetIssue/payments` | Payments for `assetIssueTransactionId` |
| 5 | PATCH | `/assetIssue` | Update member/dates |
| 6 | POST | `/assetIssue/return` | Return lines; optional deposit settlement |
| 7 | GET | `/assetIssue/return` | List returns ΓÇö no payments |
| 8 | GET | `/assetIssue/return/payments` | Return settlement (`assetReturnTransactionId`) |

**Return:** `returnCondition` required per item. `securityAmount` + `fineAmount` must be sent together for settlement. `paymentMethod`: `cash` \| `credit_card` \| `bank_transfer` \| `cheque`.

request.description:
**POST /assetIssue**

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `memberId`, `memberType` | yes | `STUDENT` or `TEACHER` |
| `issueDate`, `dueDate` | yes | `dueDate` >= `issueDate` |
| `items[]` | yes | `{ assetInventoryItemId }` ΓÇö copy must not already be on open issue |
| `securityAmount` | no | Creates `ASSET_SECURITY` payment when set |
| `paymentMethod` | no | Default `cash`; also `credit_card`, `bank_transfer`, `cheque` |

Response: issue row + `items[]` + optional `securityPayment`. Sets `assetIssueTransaction_id`, `assetIssueInventoryItem_id`.
**GET /assetIssue** ΓÇö paginated issues. Each row: `memberBasicDetails`, `issuedTotalItems` (lines on this issue), `returnedTotalItems` (returned lines), `items[]` (no payments).

**GET /assetIssue/payments?assetIssueTransactionId=** ΓÇö payments for one issue.

Response: `memberBasicDetails` (issue member) + `payments[]` each with `payeeDetails` (name, scholarNumber/course for student; employeeName/code for teacher).

`paymentPurpose`: `ASSET_SECURITY` | `RETURN_SETTLEMENT`.

**GET /assetIssue/single?assetIssueTransactionId=** ΓÇö same as list row: `issuedTotalItems`, `returnedTotalItems`, `items[]`, optional `securityPayment`. Use **get issue payments by id** for `payments[]` only.
**PATCH /assetIssue** ΓÇö `assetIssueTransactionId` + optional `memberId`, `memberType`, `issueDate`, `dueDate`. Returns same shape as GET single.

**POST /assetIssue/return** ΓÇö with deposit settlement.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `returnDate` | yes | `YYYY-MM-DD`; >= each line `issueDate` |
| `items[]` | yes | `assetIssueInventoryItemId`, `returnCondition`, optional `damageNotes` |
| `securityAmount`, `fineAmount` | together | Both required to record settlement payment; omit both for return-only (see **return (no settlement)**) |
| `paymentMethod` | no | Default `cash` |

Sets `assetReturnTransaction_id`. Use **get return payments by id** for settlement details.
**POST /assetIssue/return** ΓÇö return only (no `securityAmount` / `fineAmount`). No deposit settlement payment.
**GET /assetIssue/return** ΓÇö `data.assetReturnTransactions[]` (`returnDate`, `items[]`), `pagination`. No payment rows (use **get return payments by id**).

**GET /assetIssue/return/payments?assetReturnTransactionId=** ΓÇö settlement payment(s) for this return only.

Response: `memberBasicDetails` (member from returned lines) + `payments[]` each with `payeeDetails`. Empty `payments[]` if no settlement recorded.

item.description:
Updated tenant setup APIs for **campus**, **institute**, **affiliated university**, and **specialization**.

**Auth:** Bearer `{{token}}`. Campus routes are university-scoped; institute/affiliated-university routes bypass institute/academic-year scoping; specialization uses institute + academic-year scope from token/headers.

**Suggested flow:**
1. **campus → create campus** — sets `{{campus_id}}`
2. **campus → update campus (PATCH)** — full payload edit
3. **institute → create institute** — sets `{{institute_id}}`, `{{affiliated_university_id}}`
4. **institute → update institute (PATCH)** / **update affiliated university (PATCH)**
5. **campus → get hierarchy** — sets `{{specialization_id}}` when present
6. **specialization → update specialization (PATCH)**

**Migration:** run `20260617150000-extend-campus-fields` before testing campus create.

item.name: campus
item.description:
## campus

| Method | Path | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| POST | `/campus` | Create one campus per request |
| PATCH | `/campus` | Update campus — `campusId` required; at least one other field |
| GET | `/campus` | List campuses for authenticated university |
| GET | `/campus/hierarchy` | Nested campuses → institutes → affiliated universities → specializations |

**campusType:** `Main` \| `Regional` \| `Satellite`

**address.geoTag:** optional `{ latitude, longitude }`

request.description:
**POST /campus** — create a single campus (one per request).

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `campusName` | yes | |
| `campusCode` | yes | Unique per university |
| `campusType` | yes | `Main`, `Regional`, or `Satellite` |
| `address.addressLine` | yes | |
| `address.geoTag` | no | `{ latitude, longitude }` or `null` |
| `campusAdministrator.name` | yes | |
| `campusAdministrator.contactNumber` | yes | |
| `campusAdministrator.email` | yes | Valid email |

Sets `{{campus_id}}`. Response `data` is a single campus object.

**PATCH /campus** — update an existing campus (university-scoped).

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `campusId` | yes | |
| `campusName` | no | At least one updatable field required |
| `campusCode` | no | |
| `campusType` | no | `Main`, `Regional`, or `Satellite` |
| `address.addressLine` | no | |
| `address.geoTag` | no | `{ latitude, longitude }` or `null` to clear coords |
| `campusAdministrator.name` | no | |
| `campusAdministrator.contactNumber` | no | |
| `campusAdministrator.email` | no | Valid email |

Example sends **all** updatable fields. Response mirrors create/list shape with nested `address` and `campusAdministrator`.

**GET /campus** — list all campuses for the authenticated user's university.

Each item includes nested `address` and `campusAdministrator`.

**GET /campus/hierarchy** — university-scoped nested tree:

## Get Dashboard

**Endpoint:** `GET /dashboard`

**Authentication:** Bearer Token Required (`Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`)

### Description

Returns the complete admin dashboard in one response: student/teacher/staff KPI cards with growth, department count, fee collection overview, student course distribution, today's class stats and timeline, notice board, and institute events (jobs) for the selected date.

All sections are fetched concurrently server-side.

### Headers

|--------|----------|-------------|
| Authorization | Yes | Bearer `{{token}}` |

### Query Parameters

|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| date | String | No | Today | `YYYY-MM-DD` — reference date for `classesToday`, `classes`, `notices`, and `events` |
| limit | Number | No | 10 | Max notices to fetch before split (`1`–`50`) |
| year | Number | No | Current year | Calendar year for `fees.collectionGraph` only |
| month | Number | No | — | Month `1`–`12` for fee graph |
| week | Number | No | — | ISO week `1`–`53` for fee graph; overrides `month` when set |

### Request Body

### Success Response (200)

### Response `data` — top-level keys

| Key | Type | Description |
|-----|------|-------------|

| teachers | Object | Teacher KPI card (employees with TEACHER role) |

| classesToday | Object | `total`, `inProgress` for `date` |

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|

| pendingAmount | Number | Sum(invoice.total) − Sum(invoice.paid_amount) for generated invoices |

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| totalStudents | Number | Sum of enrolled students across listed courses |
| departmentDistribution | Array | One row per course (`course_name`) |
| departmentDistribution[].departmentName | String | Course name (program + branch) |
| departmentDistribution[].studentCount | Number | Students on that course |
| departmentDistribution[].percentage | Number | Share of `totalStudents`, rounded |

### `classes` — class item fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| time | String | Period start `HH:mm` (24h) |
| subject | String | Subject or elective name |
| teacher | String | `employee.employee_name` |
| room | String | `class_room.room_number` |
| status | String | `Upcoming`, `In Progress`, or `Completed` |

### Class / event `status` values

| Status | Rule |
|--------|------|
| Upcoming | Selected date is in the future, or current time is before period start |
| In Progress | Selected date is today and current time is within start–end |
| Completed | Selected date is in the past, or current time is after period end |

### `events` item fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| time | String | Job start time `HH:mm` |
| title | String | `jobTitle` |
| location | String | Job location |
| status | String | `Upcoming`, `In Progress`, or `Completed` (same rules as classes) |

### `notices` — audience rules

| Logged-in role | Notices returned |
|----------------|------------------|
| ADMIN | All matching notices in tenant scope |
| TEACHER | `messageTo` contains ADMIN, TEACHER, or STUDENT |
| STUDENT | `messageTo` contains STUDENT or `Student` |

Effective date = `noticeDate`, or `publishDate` when `noticeDate` is empty. Only notices with effective date `>= date` are returned. `role` for filtering comes from `req.user.defaultRole` (not a query param).

### Error Codes

| Status | Reason |
|--------|--------|
| 400 | Invalid query params or missing tenant scope |
| 401 | Unauthorized |
| 500 | Internal Server Error |

## Get Teacher Dashboard KPI

**HTTP method:** GET

**Endpoint:** GET /dashboard/teacher

**Authentication:** Bearer Token Required (Authorization: Bearer {{token}})

### Description

Returns KPI counts for one teacher dashboard card set. This endpoint accepts one employeeId and returns only a single data object containing counts. It does not return detail arrays.

All data is scoped by the authenticated tenant context and current/default academic year.

### Query Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| employeeId | Number | Yes | - | Teacher employee ID. |

### Success Response (200)

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Teacher dashboard fetched successfully",
  "data": {
    "studentsCount": 126,
    "subjectsCount": 3,
    "coursesCount": 2,
    "examScheduledForPaperCreationCount": 4,
    "upcomingClassesCount": 8
  }
}
```

### Response Field Documentation

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| studentsCount | Number | Distinct students from class-section terms taught/mapped to the teacher. |
| subjectsCount | Number | Distinct subjects mapped/taught by the teacher. |
| coursesCount | Number | Distinct courses mapped/taught by the teacher. |
| examScheduledForPaperCreationCount | Number | Exam schedules assigned to the teacher for paper creation. |
| upcomingClassesCount | Number | Upcoming published class schedule rows for the teacher. |

### Business Rules

* employeeId is required and must be a positive integer.
* Academic year comes from auth context, not from query string.
* This is a KPI-only API; response data contains counts only.
* Student count avoids double-counting the same student ID across direct placement and class-student mapper placement.

|--------|--------|
| 400 | employeeId validation failed or tenant scope missing |
| 401 | Unauthorized |
| 404 | Teacher not found |
| 500 | Internal Server Error |

Past timetable slots for a teacher (published routines, scoped by auth academic year).

### Query
| Param | Required | Notes |

| `employeeId` | yes | Teacher employeeId |

| `date` | no | Cutoff date; slots before this date only |

### Attendance status (per period)
Each schedule row includes **`attendanceStatus`**:
- `MARKED` — at least one attendance row exists for `timeTableMappingId` + `date`
- `PENDING` — not marked yet

### Grouped mode (`groupPeriods=true`)
Consecutive periods merge into one object with `classScheduleItems[]` and group-level **`attendanceStatus`**:
- `MARKED` — all periods in the group are marked
- `PARTIAL` — some marked, some pending
- `PENDING` — none marked

**Note:** `POST /attendance` accepts `timeTableMappingId` as a number or array — one POST can mark all periods in a group.

### 200 response shape
```json

  "teacher": { "employeeId", "employeeName", "employeeCode", "pickColor" },
  "schedules": [ ... ]
}
```

**HTTP method:** GET

**Endpoint:** GET /employee/subject

**Authentication:** Bearer Token Required (Authorization: Bearer {{token}})

### Description

Returns subject mappings for a teacher from teacher_subject_mapping with nested subject, course, and internal assessment data.

Use this API when loading a teacher's subjects. The optional term filter limits the result to subjects for a specific program term.

### Query Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| employeeId | Number | Yes | - | Teacher employee ID. |
| sessionId | Number | No | - | Filters subjects to courses available in the selected session. |
| term | Number | No | - | Filters subjects by subject.term and nested internal assessments by internal_assessment.term. |

### Success Response (200)

```json

    "teacherSubjectMappingId": 201,
    "employeeId": 99,
    "subjectId": 304,

      "term": 3,
      "courseInfo": {
        "courseId": 34,
        "courseName": "Bachelor of Architecture",
        "courseCode": "BARCH"
      },
      "subjectAssessments": [
        {
          "examAssessmentId": 101,
```

request.description:
## Get Course Class Sections By Year

**HTTP method:** GET

**Endpoint:** GET /course/termsWithClassSections

**Authentication:** Bearer Token Required (Authorization: Bearer {{token}})

### Description

Returns compact course/session details with class sections grouped by year.

Use this API when the frontend needs to show sections for a selected course and session. The response is no longer grouped by term and no longer returns classSectionTermId.

### Query Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| courseId | Number | Yes | - | Course ID. |
| sessionId | Number | Yes | - | Session ID. |

### Success Response (200)

```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "data": {
    "course": {
      "courseId": 45,
      "courseName": "Bachelor of Architecture",
      "courseCode": "BARCH",
      "termType": "Sem",
      "totalTerms": 6,
      "duration": 3
    },
    "session": {
      "sessionId": 23,
      "sessionName": "CST Test Session"
    },
    "years": [
      {
        "year": 1,
        "classSections": [
          {
            "classSectionsId": 101,
            "section": "A",
            "studentCount": 42
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "year": 2,
        "classSections": [
          {
            "classSectionsId": 102,
            "section": "B",
            "studentCount": 38
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| course.courseId | Number | Course ID. |
| course.courseName | String | Course name. |
| course.courseCode | String | Course code. |
| course.termType | String | Term type label, for example Sem. |
| course.totalTerms | Number | Total program terms. |
| course.duration | Number | Course duration value from course setup. |
| session.sessionId | Number | Session ID. |
| session.sessionName | String | Session name. |
| years[].year | Number | Course year. |
| years[].classSections[].classSectionsId | Number | Class section ID. |
| years[].classSections[].section | String | Section name. |
| years[].classSections[].studentCount | Number | Distinct students assigned to any term for this class section (`students` + `class_student_mapper`). |

### Removed Fields

| Field | Status | Replacement |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| termName | Removed | Use course.termType / course.totalTerms for summary display. |
| term | Removed from grouping | Response groups by years[].year. |
| classSectionTermId | Removed | Use classSectionsId for this basic section list. |
| id / name | Removed | Use classSectionsId / section. |

### Business Rules

* Course and session are scoped by authenticated tenant context.
* Class sections are grouped by class_sections.year.
* Only minimal IDs are returned: courseId and classSectionsId.
* No raw term placement IDs are returned in this response.

### Error Codes

| Status | Reason |
|--------|--------|
| 400 | courseId or sessionId validation failed |
| 401 | Unauthorized |
| 404 | Course or session not found |
| 500 | Internal Server Error |

### Changelog

- Removed termName, term grouping, classSectionTermId, id, and name fields.
- Added courseName, courseCode, termType, totalTerms, duration, sessionName, and year grouping.
- Added `studentCount` on each class section.
